Anomaly detection for any metrics data source

Find spikes, dips, level shifts, flatlines, and gaps in metrics from Mimir, Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics, or any Grafana data source that returns time series. OpenTelemetry metrics work through whichever of those stores them.

Status: the detection engine is available and tested. The Grafana data source plugin and the Explorer page are in development. Until they ship, ask the chat assistant about anomalies.

Features Quick start Findings Settings Limits Roadmap Troubleshooting Changelog

Related guides: GPU observability stack, Chat assistant.

Features

  • Needs no training and no history beyond the window you give it. Every finding says why it was raised.
  • Treats a steady rhythm, such as a batch job switching on and off, as normal, and reports it separately.
  • Ignores changes too small to matter, however clean they are statistically.
  • Finds the labels that anomalous series share, such as one datacenter, and series that changed together.
  • Works on data frames, so it does not depend on one metrics backend.

Quick start

Run the engine tests. They run in a container, so you need only Docker and make.

make anomaly-test

The engine is a Go package at backend/services/anomaly-engine/anomaly. A zero Options value uses the defaults.

report := anomaly.Analyze(points, anomaly.Options{})
for _, f := range report.Findings {
    fmt.Println(f.Kind, anomaly.ISO(f.PeakTS), f.Score, f.Detail)
}

Findings

KindMeaning
spike, dipA point, or a short run, far from the rolling median.
level_shiftThe typical value moved and stayed there.
flatlineThe value stopped changing in a series that normally moves. Often a stuck exporter.
gapSamples are missing for much longer than the sampling step.

Settings

The engine has no environment variables. These options tune a detection run.

OptionDefaultEffect
Sensitivity4.5Score threshold in robust standard deviations. Lower finds more.
MinScale0Smallest noise level to assume. Set it for counts.
MinEffectRatio0.05Ignore changes smaller than this share of the typical value.
TracefalseAlso return the expected value and score for each sample, to draw a band.

Limits

  • Run detection on the right query: use rate(...) for counters, because a series that only increases reports a shift.
  • A step in a series that repeats on a cycle is placed within a quarter of a cycle of its true position. About 1 in 100 such steps does not clear the threshold.
  • At sensitivity 3, ordinary noise trips now and then. The default of 4.5 almost never does.
  • Request at most about 1000 points per series.

Roadmap

  1. Detection engine: done.
  2. Data source plugin: wraps any data source and returns the series, an expected value, a band, and an anomaly score. Works in panels, Explore, and alert rules.
  3. Explorer page and panel menu action: find anomalies from any panel and see the likely cause.
  4. Alerting: alert rules on the wrapper data source, with no separate scheduler.

Each wrapper data source is bound to one inner data source by an administrator. In open-source Grafana, the service account token it uses can query every data source in the organization, so use a dedicated service account.

Troubleshooting

SymptomCause and fix
directory prefix . does not contain modules listed in go.work or their selected dependenciesYou ran go test on the host. Use make anomaly-test.
A report has InsufficientData setThe series has fewer than 12 usable samples. Widen the time range or use a smaller step.
A cycling series reports a spike on the edge of a cycleThe period was detected a sample off. The engine refines it, so report a series that still does this.
